ejd1gxvb61.s: The previous package did several things well enough to keep:
ejd1gxvb61.t: 先前的资料包有几项做得足够好，值得保留：

1bf2nhmr6zk.s: ⟦1⟧Local identifiability over global latent architecture.⟦/1⟧ The old unconstrained interaction matrix was correctly retired.
1bf2nhmr6zk.t: ⟦1⟧局部可识别性优先于全局潜在架构。⟦/1⟧旧的无约束交互矩阵被正确地弃用了。

kj5zbbw6pr.s: ⟦1⟧Capacity-only claims.⟦/1⟧ No result about internal monitoring licenses a phenomenality claim.
kj5zbbw6pr.t: ⟦1⟧仅限能力的主张。⟦/1⟧任何关于内部监控的结果都不能支持关于现象性的主张。

13f90445tuq.s: ⟦1⟧The information seam as an experimental scaffold.⟦/1⟧ Restricted access can create an identifiable communication problem without being asserted as literal neuroanatomy.
13f90445tuq.t: ⟦1⟧作为实验支架的信息接缝。⟦/1⟧受限访问可以构造出一个可识别的通信问题，而无需断言其为字面意义上的神经解剖结构。

vqkx15jf10.s: ⟦1⟧Rate spent versus information delivered.⟦/1⟧ ⟦2⟧ remains a load-bearing distinction.
vqkx15jf10.t: ⟦1⟧消耗的速率与交付的信息。⟦/1⟧⟦2⟧仍是一项起关键支撑作用的区分。

y81l8n61et.s: ⟦1⟧Joint benefit surfaces.⟦/1⟧ Complementarity and substitution should be measured rather than assumed away.
y81l8n61et.t: ⟦1⟧联合收益曲面。⟦/1⟧互补与替代应当加以测量，而不是通过假设予以排除。

h4m2see6wf.t: ⟦1⟧因果使用。⟦/1⟧可解码性并不充分。

ewot45j4jo.s: ⟦1⟧Optimization validity.⟦/1⟧ Posterior/channel collapse and training history can masquerade as scientific allocation preferences.
ewot45j4jo.t: ⟦1⟧优化有效性。⟦/1⟧后验/通道坍缩和训练历史可能伪装成具有科学意义的分配偏好。

1s0opp2ye8.s: ⟦1⟧Role/implementation separation.⟦/1⟧ Functional claims should survive implementation controls where technically feasible.
1s0opp2ye8.t: ⟦1⟧角色与实现的分离。⟦/1⟧在技术可行的情况下，功能性主张应当经受住实现层面的控制检验。

1f54rhxafdp.s: ⟦1⟧Stage gates and kill criteria.⟦/1⟧ Expensive methods and broader claims are conditional on simpler pilots.
1f54rhxafdp.t: ⟦1⟧阶段关卡与终止标准。⟦/1⟧昂贵的方法和更宽泛的主张都以更简单的试点研究为前提。

25pnbwl4wbu.s: ⟦1⟧Attention privilege.⟦/1⟧ Attention becomes one candidate control process, not the privileged residual target of the programme.
25pnbwl4wbu.t: ⟦1⟧注意的特权地位。⟦/1⟧注意成为候选控制过程之一，而不再是本研究计划享有特权的剩余目标。

16t36boc6nu.s: ⟦1⟧The old definition of metarepresentation.⟦/1⟧ A message about an internal controller is now called an ⟦2⟧internal-state model⟦/2⟧ unless stricter representational criteria are independently satisfied.
16t36boc6nu.t: ⟦1⟧元表征的旧定义。⟦/1⟧关于某个内部控制器的消息，除非独立满足更严格的表征标准，否则现称为⟦2⟧内部状态模型⟦/2⟧。

1vga9k6zr03.s: ⟦1⟧One global coordinator.⟦/1⟧ ⟦2⟧ is a tractable experimental consumer, not a theory of cognitive headquarters.
1vga9k6zr03.t: ⟦1⟧单一全局协调者。⟦/1⟧⟦2⟧是一个易于处理的实验性消费者，而非关于认知总部的理论。

aiu7jxq2ro.s: ⟦1⟧One global resource currency.⟦/1⟧ A single rate budget is a controlled experimental manipulation, not a claim about one biological pool.
aiu7jxq2ro.t: ⟦1⟧单一全局资源通货。⟦/1⟧单一速率预算是一种受控的实验操纵，并非关于某个单一生物资源池的主张。

22uomrrcfdc.s: ⟦1⟧Astrocyte as default method.⟦/1⟧ Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization is optional infrastructure, not a prerequisite for the first experiment.
22uomrrcfdc.t: ⟦1⟧以 Astrocyte 为默认方法。⟦/1⟧高斯过程贝叶斯优化是可选的基础设施，而非首个实验的前提条件。

3xzkp634eb.s: ⟦1⟧Doerig as the programme’s ontology.⟦/1⟧ Doerig-style adversarial pressure is retained; consciousness-specific inferential criteria are not imported where phenomenality is no longer the explanandum.
3xzkp634eb.t: ⟦1⟧以 Doerig 为本研究计划的本体论。⟦/1⟧保留 Doerig 式的对抗性压力；但在现象性不再是被解释项之处，不引入意识特有的推断标准。

116qz8bne2d.s: 2. What would count as an ecology-level result? →
116qz8bne2d.t: 2. 什么才算生态层面的结果？ →

kfcf16y699.s: A single second-order signal does not make an ecology. Neither do three modules drawn in a diagram.
kfcf16y699.t: 单个二阶信号并不构成生态。在图中画出三个模块同样不构成生态。

16kejlzn29m.s: An ecology-level result requires at least one ⟦1⟧relational regularity⟦/1⟧ that predicts how one internal model changes the value, fidelity, use, or resource allocation of another across more than one condition.
16kejlzn29m.t: 生态层面的结果要求至少存在一条⟦1⟧关系规律⟦/1⟧，能够预测一个内部模型如何在不止一种条件下改变另一个内部模型的价值、保真度、使用或资源分配。

1s3jp1xo3nw.s: ⟦1⟧competition⟦/1⟧ - models trade off under a demonstrably shared constraint;
1s3jp1xo3nw.t: ⟦1⟧竞争⟦/1⟧ - 各模型在一个可证明为共享的约束下相互权衡；

213d88v0yfe.s: ⟦1⟧complementarity⟦/1⟧ - one model increases the marginal utility of another;
213d88v0yfe.t: ⟦1⟧互补⟦/1⟧ - 一个模型提高另一个模型的边际效用；

1w040noww3x.s: ⟦1⟧substitution⟦/1⟧ - one model reduces the marginal utility of another;
1w040noww3x.t: ⟦1⟧替代⟦/1⟧ - 一个模型降低另一个模型的边际效用；

28woloqh8rb.s: ⟦1⟧causal-topological dependence⟦/1⟧ - monitoring value tracks causal role/position rather than implementation identity;
28woloqh8rb.t: ⟦1⟧因果拓扑依赖⟦/1⟧ - 监控价值追踪的是因果角色/位置，而非实现身份；

1dt76s8wacx.s: ⟦1⟧recursive regulation⟦/1⟧ - a model of a control process changes subsequent control;
1dt76s8wacx.t: ⟦1⟧递归调节⟦/1⟧ - 关于某一控制过程的模型改变后续控制；

62bczyndsp.s: ⟦1⟧fidelity dependence⟦/1⟧ - downstream use scales with calibrated accuracy, not merely decodability;
62bczyndsp.t: ⟦1⟧保真度依赖⟦/1⟧ - 下游使用随校准后的准确度而变化，而不仅仅随可解码性而变化；

1ypez6zfcro.s: ⟦1⟧temporal niche⟦/1⟧ - optimal/useful monitoring differs systematically with volatility, persistence, lag, or control horizon.
1ypez6zfcro.t: ⟦1⟧时间生态位⟦/1⟧ - 最优/有用的监控随波动性、持续性、滞后或控制时域而系统性地不同。

20j6ir32jjr.t: 本研究计划并不假定这七类关系全部存在。

ijqh4yq33n.s: P1. Emergent communication in multi-agent RL under bandwidth constraints →
ijqh4yq33n.t: P1. 带宽约束下多智能体强化学习中的涌现通信 →

1knkozjnrnc.t: [R4 · 更正，2026 年 8 月审阅轮次]

sm2i7p76cs.s: Constraint C5 of Document I requires that no novelty claim survive an unsearched prior-art row. That constraint was executed thoroughly on the metacognition and consciousness-methodology side and ⟦1⟧not⟦/1⟧ on the information-theory, control, and reinforcement-learning side. Five literatures substantially overlap E1, E3 and E4 and were absent from earlier drafts. Each is given a paragraph here stating what it established and where this programme actually differs. Where the difference is thin, that is said. A sixth family — the nearest neurocomputational neighbours — was still missing after that pass and is added as P6 in the second external review pass.
sm2i7p76cs.t: 文件 I 的约束 C5 要求：只要存在未经检索的先前工作条目，任何新颖性主张都不得成立。该约束在元认知与意识方法论一侧得到了彻底执行，而在信息论、控制与强化学习一侧则⟦1⟧没有⟦/1⟧。有五类文献与 E1、E3 和 E4 存在实质性重叠，却未出现在早期草稿中。此处为每一类文献各写一段，说明其已确立的内容以及本研究计划实际的不同之处。凡差异单薄之处，均如实说明。第六类——最接近的神经计算近邻——在该轮审阅之后仍然缺失，已在第二轮外部审阅中作为 P6 补入。

2feu40i9eom.s: Learned communication protocols over limited channels are an established subfield. DIAL and RIAL (Foerster et al. 2016) learn discrete and differentiable protocols end to end; SchedNet (Kim et al. 2019) learns ⟦1⟧which⟦/1⟧ agents may transmit over a contested channel by learned importance weights; IMAC (Wang et al. 2020) derives a mutual-information upper bound as an explicit bandwidth constraint and learns low-entropy messages; VBC (Zhang et al. 2019) prunes communication by variance. E1 — learned agents allocating a shared information rate across sources, with messages tested for causal use — is structurally close to this work, and the resemblance should be stated before a reviewer states it. Three differences are defensible. The sources are ⟦2⟧internal control states of a single agent⟦/2⟧ rather than other agents’ observations of external world state, so encoder and consumer share a body and a reward. The ⟦3⟧scientific object is the allocation law measured against an empirically estimated benefit surface⟦/3⟧, rather than task return maximised by any protocol that works. And ⟦4⟧causal-use validation is a gate rather than a diagnostic⟦/4⟧: a decodable but behaviourally inert channel fails E0-A outright. Honesty about the first difference: a single agent with private modules and a shared reward is formally close to a cooperative multi-agent system, and the architectural distinction alone will not carry the positioning. The scientific one will.
2feu40i9eom.t: 在受限信道上学习通信协议是一个已确立的子领域。DIAL 与 RIAL（Foerster et al. 2016）端到端地学习离散与可微的协议；SchedNet（Kim et al. 2019）通过学习得到的重要性权重，学习⟦1⟧哪些⟦/1⟧智能体可以在争用信道上发送；IMAC（Wang et al. 2020）推导出互信息上界作为显式带宽约束，并学习低熵消息；VBC（Zhang et al. 2019）按方差削减通信。E1——学习型智能体在多个来源之间分配共享信息速率，并检验消息是否被因果使用——在结构上与这项工作十分接近，这种相似性应在审稿人指出之前由我们自己说明。有三点差异站得住脚。来源是⟦2⟧单个智能体的内部控制状态⟦/2⟧，而非其他智能体对外部世界状态的观测，因此编码器与消费者共享同一躯体和同一奖励。⟦3⟧科学对象是对照经验估计的收益曲面加以测量的分配律⟦/3⟧，而非任何有效协议所最大化的任务回报。并且，⟦4⟧因果使用验证是一道关卡而非诊断手段⟦/4⟧：一个可解码但在行为上惰性的信道会直接未通过 E0-A。关于第一点差异须坦诚：具有私有模块和共享奖励的单个智能体在形式上接近合作式多智能体系统，仅凭架构上的区分不足以支撑这一定位。能够支撑它的是科学上的区分。

1kh2rxze7wj.s: ← 2. What would count as an ecology-level result?
1kh2rxze7wj.t: ← 2. 什么才算生态层面的结果？

1t29iaizoiw.s: Ortega and Braun’s free-energy formulation, and Genewein et al. (2015) on hierarchical decision-making under an information-processing cost, establish the trade-off between expected utility and rate as an optimality principle, with antecedents in Tishby and Polani (2011) and in linearly-solvable control. The ⟦1⟧ versus ⟦2⟧ distinction and the KL rate cost used throughout this package live ⟦3⟧inside⟦/3⟧ this tradition and are inherited from it, not derived here; they should be cited accordingly. The difference is one of direction. That literature specifies the trade-off normatively and derives optimal policies from it. E1 applies the constraint to self-monitoring specifically and ⟦4⟧measures⟦/4⟧ the benefit surface empirically rather than assuming a parametric form for it — which is what permits interaction, non-concavity, and failure of separability to appear as findings rather than as violated assumptions.
1t29iaizoiw.t: Ortega 与 Braun 的自由能表述，以及 Genewein et al.（2015）关于信息处理成本下分层决策的研究，将期望效用与速率之间的权衡确立为一条最优性原理，其先驱可见于 Tishby 与 Polani（2011）以及线性可解控制。本资料包通篇使用的⟦1⟧与⟦2⟧之区分以及 KL 速率成本，都处于这一传统⟦3⟧之内⟦/3⟧，是从中继承而来，而非在此推导所得；应据此加以引用。差异在于方向。该文献以规范方式设定这一权衡，并由此推导最优策略。E1 则专门将该约束应用于自我监控，并以经验方式⟦4⟧测量⟦/4⟧收益曲面，而不为其假定参数形式——正是这一点使交互作用、非凹性以及可分离性的失效能够作为发现而非作为被违背的假设出现。

f6chqw2vd9.s: ← P1. Emergent communication in multi-agent RL under bandwidth constraints
f6chqw2vd9.t: ← P1. 带宽约束下多智能体强化学习中的涌现通信

zgdw0q4m66.s: Sims (2003) formalised capacity-constrained attention allocation under a Shannon cost; Caplin and Dean (2015) supplied revealed-preference tests for costly information acquisition. H1 is, in structure, a rational-inattention hypothesis pointed inward, and this is the collision most likely to be recognised by a cognitive scientist rather than only by a machine-learning reviewer. Two differences. Rational inattention constrains the acquisition of ⟦1⟧external⟦/1⟧ state; here the constrained resource is applied to states the agent itself generates, where the benefit accrues to control of control rather than to decision accuracy. More importantly: rational inattention ⟦2⟧assumes the optimum is attained⟦/2⟧ and derives behaviour from that premise. This programme treats attainment as the empirical question. The real content of H1 and H2 is not whether a capacity-constrained optimum exists — it does — but whether a learning system operating under realistic optimisation pathologies finds it, and what it does instead when it does not.
zgdw0q4m66.t: Sims（2003）在香农成本下形式化了容量受限的注意力分配；Caplin 与 Dean（2015）为代价高昂的信息获取提供了显示偏好检验。H1 在结构上是一个指向内部的理性疏忽假设，而这也是最可能被认知科学家（而不仅仅是机器学习审稿人）识别出的冲突。差异有二。理性疏忽约束的是对⟦1⟧外部⟦/1⟧状态的获取；而在此处，受约束的资源被用于智能体自身生成的状态，其收益归于对控制的控制，而非决策准确性。更重要的是：理性疏忽⟦2⟧假定最优点已被达到⟦/2⟧，并由这一前提推导行为。本研究计划则将能否达到视为经验问题。H1 与 H2 的真正内容并不在于容量受限的最优点是否存在——它确实存在——而在于一个在现实优化病态下运行的学习系统能否找到它，以及在找不到时转而做什么。

g3x8n60lxk.t: P4. 信息价值传感器调度与网络化控制 →

1mefi03w245.s: “Which sensor’s state is worth transmitting under a communication constraint” has been formalised for decades. Imer and Başar (2005), Lipsa and Martins (2011), and Gao, Akyol and Başar (2018) treat remote estimation in which communication is limited or explicitly priced; Gao et al. directly distinguish soft transmission costs from a hard limit on transmission opportunities. Sequential rate-distortion work by Tanaka et al. (2017), and later finite-rate sequential source coding by Stavrou, Skoglund and Tanaka (2022), formalises closely related rate–distortion and encoder-design problems for dynamical systems. ⟦1⟧Some E1 specialisations are formally very close to this problem class⟦/1⟧, and pretending otherwise would be indefensible; the package does not claim a general isomorphism without an explicit mapping of state, information pattern, objective and constraint. The differences are that the intended sources are non-Gaussian and low-cardinality internal control states, the distortion analogue is expected return rather than quadratic estimation error, and the encoders are ⟦2⟧learned rather than designed⟦/2⟧. The right posture toward this literature is not defensive. Per Document I §8.1, a deliberately constructed solved linear-Gaussian case is not a competitor but a ⟦3⟧validation target⟦/3⟧: a learned allocation that cannot recover a known optimum where one exists has not earned interpretation where none does.
1mefi03w245.t: “在通信约束下哪个传感器的状态值得传输”这一问题已被形式化了数十年。Imer 与 Başar（2005）、Lipsa 与 Martins（2011）以及 Gao、Akyol 与 Başar（2018）研究了通信受限或被显式定价的远程估计；Gao et al. 直接区分了软性传输成本与对传输机会的硬性限制。Tanaka et al.（2017）的序贯率失真研究，以及后来 Stavrou、Skoglund 与 Tanaka（2022）的有限速率序贯信源编码，形式化了动态系统中密切相关的率失真与编码器设计问题。⟦1⟧E1 的某些特化形式在形式上与这一问题类别非常接近⟦/1⟧，否认这一点是站不住脚的；在未对状态、信息结构、目标与约束给出显式映射的情况下，本资料包不主张存在一般性的同构。差异在于：预期的来源是非高斯、低基数的内部控制状态，失真的类比量是期望回报而非二次估计误差，且编码器是⟦2⟧学习得到的而非设计出来的⟦/2⟧。对待这一文献的正确姿态不是防御性的。按照文件 I §8.1，一个刻意构造的、已求解的线性高斯情形不是竞争者，而是⟦3⟧验证目标⟦/3⟧：一个在已知最优解存在之处都无法恢复该最优解的学习型分配，在不存在已知最优解之处也无权获得解释。

1yja893ss59.s: P5. Rational metareasoning and value of computation →
1yja893ss59.t: P5. 理性元推理与计算价值 →

316p0snrr7.s: Russell and Wefald (1991) and Hay, Russell, Tolpin and Shimony (2012) price a computation by its expected effect on the decision it informs. The hypothesis that monitoring value tracks causal position and downstream reach — ⟦1⟧H2⟦/1⟧ in this document, ⟦2⟧H4⟦/2⟧ in the Master’s scoping document — overlaps conceptually with value of computation, and the overlap must be stated. Graph position and value of computation are not identical, but they are close enough that a topology result could be a VOC result wearing different notation.
316p0snrr7.t: Russell和Wefald（1991）以及Hay、Russell、Tolpin和Shimony（2012）依据一次计算对其所服务的决策的预期影响为该计算定价。监控价值追踪因果位置与下游影响范围这一假设——在本文件中为⟦1⟧H2⟦/1⟧，在硕士范围界定文件中为⟦2⟧H4⟦/2⟧——在概念上与计算价值重叠，而这种重叠必须予以说明。图位置与计算价值并不等同，但二者足够接近，以至于一项拓扑结果可能只是换了一套记法的VOC结果。

18syyk8uvb4.s: ⟦1⟧[Revised after release-candidate review.]⟦/1⟧ An earlier version of this paragraph described VOC as “myopic and per-item” and contrasted that with a joint, constrained Sīdus problem. That characterisation was wrong. Rational metareasoning is formulated as a ⟦2⟧metalevel MDP⟦/2⟧; the myopic or meta-greedy policy is one ⟦3⟧approximation⟦/3⟧ within that framework, not its definition, and Hay et al. explicitly analyse the relation between myopic and optimal metalevel policies. Exact metalevel policies are intractable in general, which is why myopic approximations are used in practice — a fact that applies symmetrically to ⟦4⟧ and is already covered by anti-slop rule 5.
18syyk8uvb4.t: ⟦1⟧[发布候选版审阅后修订。]⟦/1⟧本段的早先版本将VOC描述为“短视的、逐项的”，并将其与一个联合的、受约束的Sīdus问题相对照。这一刻画是错误的。理性元推理被表述为一个⟦2⟧元层级MDP⟦/2⟧；短视或元贪婪策略只是该框架内的一种⟦3⟧近似⟦/3⟧，而非其定义，且Hay等人明确分析了短视元层级策略与最优元层级策略之间的关系。精确的元层级策略在一般情况下是难以处理的，这正是实践中采用短视近似的原因——这一事实同样对称地适用于⟦4⟧，并已由反粗劣规则5涵盖。

11bcgs9gfcl.s: The honest differences are narrower. VOC prices ⟦1⟧computations against a decision⟦/1⟧; the allocation problem prices ⟦2⟧channels against each other⟦/2⟧ under a binding shared budget, where sources may be complementary or substitutable. Neither is tractable in general; both enter as benchmarks rather than as claims about what any system computes. For the separable, non-interacting case they converge, which is why a ⟦3⟧specified myopic-VOC baseline⟦/3⟧ belongs in the comparison set rather than in a related-work paragraph. If the joint resource surface fails to improve out-of-sample prediction over myopic VOC, the experiment provides ⟦4⟧no incremental predictive evidence⟦/4⟧ for the interaction structure this programme is built to detect beyond that simpler benchmark.
11bcgs9gfcl.t: 真正的差异更为有限。VOC将⟦1⟧计算相对于决策⟦/1⟧进行定价；分配问题则在一个有约束力的共享预算下将⟦2⟧通道相互之间⟦/2⟧进行定价，其中各信源可能互补，也可能可相互替代。二者在一般情况下均难以处理；二者都作为基准引入，而非作为关于任何系统实际计算什么的主张。在可分离、无相互作用的情形下，二者趋于一致，这正是⟦3⟧一个明确设定的短视VOC基线⟦/3⟧应列入比较集合、而非仅出现在相关工作段落中的原因。如果联合资源曲面未能在样本外预测上优于短视VOC，则该实验在这一更简单的基准之外，⟦4⟧不提供任何增量预测证据⟦/4⟧来支持本研究计划旨在检测的相互作用结构。

qbcq38d2ab.t: P6. 精度加权、作为资源的注意与工作记忆限制 →

24qfbufau0e.s: ⟦1⟧[Second external review pass — neuroscience-side C5.]⟦/1⟧ The nearest neurocomputational neighbours are not source-coding problems at all, and they constrain a different part of the programme. Expected-precision accounts of attention (Feldman & Friston 2010) treat attention as the optimisation of precision estimates that weight first-order sensory evidence — formally, E2’s consumer using ⟦2⟧ to weight first-order representations ⟦3⟧is⟦/3⟧ precision weighting, and any neuroscience-facing reading of E2 must say so. Attention-as-resource (Kahneman 1973) is the classical ancestor of every shared-budget intuition in this package. The working-memory slots-versus-resources debate (Ma, Husain & Bays 2014) shows that even for the best-studied candidate “shared pool” in cognition, the existence of a single common currency is contested rather than established. None of this changes the synthetic thesis, which makes no biological budget claim. It becomes load-bearing at E6, where these literatures — not the source-coding apparatus — set the standard of evidence for any human translation.
24qfbufau0e.t: ⟦1⟧[第二轮外部审阅——神经科学方面C5。]⟦/1⟧最接近的神经计算近邻根本不是信源编码问题，它们约束的是本研究计划的另一部分。注意的期望精度理论（Feldman & Friston 2010）将注意视为对精度估计的优化，这些估计对一阶感觉证据进行加权——从形式上看，E2的消费者利用⟦2⟧对一阶表征进行加权，⟦3⟧就是⟦/3⟧精度加权，任何面向神经科学的E2解读都必须明确这一点。作为资源的注意（Kahneman 1973）是本资料包中一切共享预算直觉的经典源头。工作记忆的“槽位与资源”之争（Ma, Husain & Bays 2014）表明，即便对于认知中研究最充分的候选“共享池”，单一通用货币是否存在也仍有争议，而非已确立。上述一切均不改变合成论题，该论题不作任何关于生物预算的主张。它在E6处变得具有关键支撑作用：在那里，为任何向人类的转化设定证据标准的，是这些文献，而非信源编码工具。

5s5mx29yf3.s: An earlier version of this section proposed a hard alphabet-cardinality budget as a mandatory second arm and made ⟦1⟧rank-order invariance across arms⟦/1⟧ a confirmatory prediction. Both claims were too strong and are withdrawn. What follows is the corrected position.
5s5mx29yf3.t: 本节早先版本提出将硬性字母表基数预算作为强制性的第二臂，并将⟦1⟧跨臂排序不变性⟦/1⟧作为一项验证性预测。这两项主张都过强，现予撤回。以下为修正后的立场。

1y91zl8ei9k.s: ⟦1⟧Arm S is the core experiment.⟦/1⟧ Primal-dual or augmented-Lagrangian training formulates ⟦2⟧ as a constrained optimisation problem rather than merely attaching a fixed penalty coefficient. In a non-convex learned system, however, ⟦3⟧feasibility is an empirical property of the trained solution⟦/3⟧, not something the optimiser name guarantees. Realised constraint violation must therefore be reported and preregistered feasibility tolerances met before the run is interpreted as genuinely budget-constrained. The second epistemic question is whether the variational surrogate corresponds tightly enough to the intended information currency — and correction R2 makes that looseness measurable:
1y91zl8ei9k.t: ⟦1⟧臂 S 是核心实验。⟦/1⟧原始-对偶或增广拉格朗日训练将⟦2⟧表述为一个约束优化问题，而不仅仅是附加一个固定的惩罚系数。然而，在非凸的习得系统中，⟦3⟧可行性是训练所得解的一种经验属性⟦/3⟧，而不是优化器名称所能保证的。因此，在将一次运行解释为真正受预算约束之前，必须报告实际的约束违反程度，并满足预注册的可行性容差。第二个认识论问题是，变分替代量是否与预期的信息货币足够紧密地对应——而修正 R2 使这种松弛程度变得可测量：

1evqtsckkt5.s: Arm S therefore requires two things to be reported alongside every allocation: realised constraint violation, and ⟦1⟧ per source as a tightness diagnostic. Those reports are what license the surrogate as a rate meter; a second arm is not needed for that purpose.
1evqtsckkt5.t: 因此，臂 S 要求在每次分配时同时报告两项内容：实际的约束违反程度，以及每个来源的⟦1⟧作为紧致性诊断。正是这些报告使替代量得以作为速率计使用；就此目的而言，不需要第二臂。

c19vhptvku.s: ⟦1⟧Why the invariance test does not work.⟦/1⟧ A KL budget and an alphabet budget are different resource currencies:
c19vhptvku.t: ⟦1⟧为何不变性检验行不通。⟦/1⟧KL 预算与字母表预算是不同的资源货币：

28f0ror0h48.s: One constrains expected informational departure from a prior; the other constrains maximum representational capacity. A source may be granted a large alphabet and use it sparsely; another may use a small alphabet efficiently. Different allocation rankings can therefore arise ⟦1⟧under perfect optimisation and an unchanged task⟦/1⟧. So
28f0ror0h48.t: 前者约束相对于先验的期望信息偏离；后者约束最大表征容量。一个来源可能被分配了较大的字母表却稀疏地使用它；另一个来源则可能高效地使用较小的字母表。因此，⟦1⟧即使在完美优化且任务不变的情况下⟦/1⟧，也可能出现不同的分配排序。所以

1r00j2fsbbo.s: does not license the conclusion that the allocation law is optimiser-dependent. The more likely reading is that allocation depends on ⟦1⟧which resource is scarce⟦/1⟧, which is interesting and is not what an invariance test claims to measure.
1r00j2fsbbo.t: 并不能支持“分配规律依赖于优化器”这一结论。更可能的解读是，分配取决于⟦1⟧哪种资源稀缺⟦/1⟧，这一点颇有意义，但并非不变性检验声称要测量的内容。

xv8act83zk.s: ⟦1⟧The alphabet arm as optional robustness.⟦/1⟧ If a stable allocation phenomenon is established in Arm S, a hard-capacity arm becomes worth running as a ⟦2⟧currency-sensitivity⟦/2⟧ experiment: does the ordering change when the scarce resource is capacity rather than expected information cost? Run that way, a divergence is a finding about currency dependence rather than a failed invariance check.
xv8act83zk.t: ⟦1⟧字母表臂作为可选的稳健性检验。⟦/1⟧如果在臂 S 中确立了稳定的分配现象，那么硬容量臂便值得作为一项⟦2⟧货币敏感性⟦/2⟧实验来运行：当稀缺资源是容量而非期望信息成本时，排序是否会改变？以这种方式运行时，出现分歧是关于货币依赖性的发现，而非不变性检验的失败。

1jx8hqk0pwl.s: If it is run, the construction matters. Per-source codebooks give each source its own hard cap and abolish competition; a single shared codebook abolishes source-factorisation and with it the per-source identifiability of ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ and targeted intervention, taking Gates A3 and A4 and H3 with it. The construction that is hard, shared and factorised at once constrains ⟦3⟧total alphabet cardinality with a learned split⟦/3⟧:
1jx8hqk0pwl.t: 如果运行该臂，构造方式至关重要。按来源设置的码本为每个来源各自设定硬上限，从而消除了竞争；单一共享码本则消除了来源因子分解，并随之丧失⟦1⟧、⟦2⟧及定向干预在每个来源层面的可识别性，关卡 A3、A4 和 H3 也随之失效。同时满足硬性、共享且因子化的构造，是以习得的划分来约束⟦3⟧字母表总基数⟦/3⟧：

288bvraktdn.s: with per-source cardinality drawn from a shared slot pool by a differentiable arbitration. That is the right way to build the arm. It is not a reason to build it before the phenomenon exists — anti-slop rule 8 applies to this proposal as much as to any other.
288bvraktdn.t: 其中每个来源的基数通过可微分仲裁从共享槽位池中抽取。这是构建该臂的正确方式，但这并不构成在现象确立之前就构建它的理由——反粗制滥造规则 8 对这一提议的适用程度不亚于其他任何提议。

2gj4026p9wa.s: Plausible targets include perception-memory confidence, source monitoring, error monitoring, and meta-control. The literature already warns against assuming strong domain generality. Human work should therefore test specific interactions and trade-offs, not merely group differences or correlations.
2gj4026p9wa.t: 可能的目标包括感知—记忆置信度、来源监控、错误监控和元控制。现有文献已经告诫不要预设强领域一般性。因此，人类研究应检验特定的相互作用和权衡，而不仅仅是组间差异或相关性。

opz8qzp430.s: The same construct discipline can test whether a model’s report about an internal state is causally faithful rather than semantically plausible. Define the internal target independently; intervene on target and report separately; vary semantic framing; preserve non-target information.
opz8qzp430.t: 同样的构念规范可用于检验模型关于某一内部状态的报告是否在因果上忠实，而非仅在语义上合理。应独立定义内部目标；分别对目标和报告进行干预；改变语义框架；保留非目标信息。

20mlfckx5u5.s: This remains post-construct-validity. Hypervigilance, interoception, alexithymia or dissociation should not be redescribed as “metarepresentational ecology” unless the framework predicts a distinctive within-person interaction or trade-off that competing accounts do not.
20mlfckx5u5.t: 这仍需在构念效度确立之后进行。除非该框架能预测出竞争性解释所无法预测的、独特的个体内相互作用或权衡，否则不应将过度警觉、内感受、述情障碍或解离重新描述为“元表征生态”。

Strict-metarepresentation experiments additionally require the relevant E0-B definition-index to pass under validated, preregistered criteria.⟦/1⟧ The detailed two-stage rule is in Document IV; an E0-A monitoring result alone does not license a strict-meta claim.

E0-B comparisons remain exploratory until their distinct index-specific rules are validated.
2expbze26a4.t: ⟦1⟧E0 参照系统与评估器⟦/1⟧：在校准试点阈值之前，使用可处理的精确概率模拟器来验证估计量和所有关卡（包括阴性对照）；此后才冻结阈值并进行独立确认。在 E0-B 各自不同的、针对具体指标的规则得到验证之前，E0-B 比较仍属探索性质。

5rsft8nvxo.t: ⟦1⟧试点阶段关卡⟦/1⟧：证明存在信息接缝、具有约束力的共享预算、稳定且有信息量的消息，以及因果使用。

1utqgl4izek.s: Not all three. A clean internal-validity audit does not establish contribution or close C5: systematic comparison with existing communication, control and metareasoning work remains an independent requirement before claiming novelty.
1utqgl4izek.t: 而不是三项全选。一次干净的内部效度审查既不能确立贡献，也不能了结 C5：在主张新颖性之前，与现有通信、控制和元推理研究进行系统比较，仍是一项独立的要求。

1rmk7nia3dz.s: A successful first paper need not mention consciousness or claim a new cognitive architecture.
1rmk7nia3dz.t: 一篇成功的首篇论文无需提及意识，也无需宣称提出了新的认知架构。

aemoacd7ob.t: 一个有力的结果可以是：

3ql0vsorkx.s: In a controlled modular agent, private internal process states competed for a binding information-rate channel. Learned allocation was predicted by the joint dynamic control benefit of monitoring those states, and transmitted information was causally used. A controlled change in causal position altered monitoring value in the predicted direction.
3ql0vsorkx.t: 在一个受控的模块化智能体中，私有的内部过程状态争夺一条具有约束力的信息速率信道。习得的分配可由监控这些状态所带来的联合动态控制收益加以预测，且所传输的信息得到了因果使用。对因果位置的受控改变使监控价值朝预测方向发生变化。

23cvck1moi5.s: A stronger later result could be:
23cvck1moi5.t: 一个更有力的后续结果可以是：

o23j18hewy.s: A separately validated metarepresentation of a first-order representational process competed with other internal models under the same constraint, and its value depended on the process’s uncertainty and causal role.
o23j18hewy.t: 一个经过单独验证的、针对一阶表征过程的元表征，在相同约束下与其他内部模型相互竞争，且其价值取决于该过程的不确定性与因果角色。

1qfqhi1gy6x.s: An ecology-level result would require more:
1qfqhi1gy6x.t: 生态层面的结果则需要更多：

feqzcbva9n.s: The same relational principle predicts interactions among multiple validated meta-systems across tasks or architectures.
feqzcbva9n.t: 同一关系性原理能够预测多个经过验证的元系统在不同任务或架构之间的相互作用。

Its scientific premises do not depend on a university, named specialisation, admissions route or planned start year.

tzpeuajt9f.s: The implementation requires artificial agents, partial observability, learned representations, information constraints, causal interventions and probabilistic model comparison. Suitable supervision combines experience building such systems with scrutiny of construct validity, identifiability and competing explanations.

1nqgn2ty5ps.s: Internal-State Monitoring Under Scarcity: Causal and Information-Theoretic Tests of Learned Resource Allocation
1nqgn2ty5ps.t: 稀缺条件下的内部状态监控：对习得性资源分配的因果与信息论检验

1npg23z4b1o.s: When several private internal control states are useful to a coordinating agent but can only be exposed through a genuinely binding shared information-rate channel, what predicts which states the agent learns to communicate, at what rate, and whether those messages are causally used?
1npg23z4b1o.t: 当若干私有的内部控制状态对一个协调智能体有用，但只能通过一条真正具有约束力的共享信息速率信道加以暴露时，什么能够预测智能体学会传达哪些状态、以何种速率传达，以及这些消息是否得到因果使用？

n520dvhm96.t: 这就是研究纲领中的⟦1⟧E1 Scarcity Terrarium⟦/1⟧。

1qrch9ocfi5.s: whether all internal-state messages are strict metarepresentations;
1qrch9ocfi5.t: 是否所有内部状态消息都是严格意义上的元表征；

28b0u1vfcm8.s: whether human cognition has one global self-monitoring budget;
28b0u1vfcm8.t: 人类认知是否具有单一的全局自我监控预算；

ly5am72ej3.t: 注意是否具有独特的特权地位。

19pprbmtkuh.s: It tests one possible organizing pressure - ⟦1⟧scarcity⟦/1⟧ - in a substrate where ground truth and interventions are available.
19pprbmtkuh.t: 它在一个可获得基本真值与干预手段的基底中，检验一种可能的组织压力——⟦1⟧稀缺⟦/1⟧。

255f5hmyqmn.s: The full programme contains at least four difficult scientific problems:
255f5hmyqmn.t: 完整的研究计划至少包含四个困难的科学问题：

7y42ut10gy.s: defining genuine metarepresentation rather than generic internal monitoring;
7y42ut10gy.t: 界定真正的元表征，而非泛泛的内部监控；

t07pubpuwk.s: discovering whether monitoring systems share resources;
t07pubpuwk.t: 发现监控系统之间是否共享资源；

ecrrvebo48.t: 识别它们之间的因果—拓扑关系；

v7wmi7s6u1.s: determining whether any of these principles generalize to biological cognition.
v7wmi7s6u1.t: 确定这些原则中是否有任何一条可推广到生物认知。

befth42hl6.s: A Master’s cannot solve all four without becoming a manifesto rather than a thesis.
befth42hl6.t: 一项硕士研究若要同时解决这四个问题，就会沦为一份宣言，而非一篇学位论文。

2tjlu1joh3.s: The chosen project has a better risk profile:
2tjlu1joh3.t: 所选项目具有更好的风险特征：

1sk0h7x3wj.s: internal states are known by construction;
1sk0h7x3wj.t: 内部状态在构造上即为已知；

q1ikjs6uv0.t: 私有性/访问权限可以受控；

o2bbm98xim.s: scarcity can be manipulated rather than inferred;
o2bbm98xim.t: 稀缺可以通过操控施加，而非仅靠推断得出；

igspkf0rgt.s: rate and incremental information can be estimated;
igspkf0rgt.t: 速率与增量信息可以被估计；

rmh5px0o11.t: 消息可以被选择性地扰动；

99ydii2uie.s: no phenomenality measurement problem is imported.
99ydii2uie.t: 不会引入现象性的测量问题。

rocs1o51bh.s: The thesis is therefore useful even if the larger ecology hypothesis is wrong.
rocs1o51bh.t: 因此，即便更大的生态假设是错误的，本论文仍然有用。

3ya3xmrkdo.s: Estimate how quickly the source can be learned under a dedicated, non-scarce channel. Keep this outside the competitive bottleneck so allocation does not contaminate the covariate used to explain allocation.
3ya3xmrkdo.t: 估计在专用的、非稀缺的通道下该来源能被多快学会。将此项置于竞争性瓶颈之外，以免分配污染用于解释分配的协变量。

oq6xuhp2.t: 为每个来源估计经验性的失真–速率曲线或收益–速率曲线。易于学习与易于压缩是两回事。

q27w31dmxv.s: Treat this as a variational rate-control surrogate.
q27w31dmxv.t: 将其视为一种变分速率控制替代指标。

1rw7tjv1or0.s: ⟦1⟧[R2 · correction, revised]⟦/1⟧ The rate–information gap is an identity, not an assumption: ⟦2⟧, where the mismatch term is an ⟦3⟧expectation over the conditioning variable⟦/3⟧, ⟦4⟧. Report ⟦5⟧ as a measured quantity alongside ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧. See Document IV, §3.3a.
1rw7tjv1or0.t: ⟦1⟧[R2 · 更正，已修订]⟦/1⟧ 速率–信息差距是一个恒等式，而非假设：⟦2⟧，其中失配项是⟦3⟧对条件变量所取的期望⟦/3⟧，⟦4⟧。将 ⟦5⟧ 作为测量量，与 ⟦6⟧ 和 ⟦7⟧ 一并报告。参见文档 IV，§3.3a。

1cxwx3gng6r.s: Do not interpret this as a claim that the learned agent explicitly solves the argmax.
1cxwx3gng6r.t: 不应将此解读为学习得到的智能体显式求解了该 argmax 的主张。

1jxpt834g17.s: H1 - Binding scarcity produces a real trade-off
1jxpt834g17.t: H1——约束性稀缺会产生真实的权衡

1qt9m28vlfq.s: As ⟦1⟧ is swept from non-binding to binding capacity, increasing rate to one source should reduce feasible rate available to others and alter performance in predictable ways.
1qt9m28vlfq.t: 当 ⟦1⟧ 从非约束性容量扫至约束性容量时，增加分配给某一来源的速率应会减少其他来源可用的可行速率，并以可预测的方式改变性能。

1fmkq72g4lu.s: ⟦1⟧Against H1:⟦/1⟧ nominally lower capacity leaves every source fully informative, or no cross-source displacement occurs despite validated rate control.
1fmkq72g4lu.t: ⟦1⟧反对 H1 的证据：⟦/1⟧名义上更低的容量仍使每个来源保持完全的信息性，或者尽管速率控制已经过验证，仍未出现跨来源的挤占。

1ijvn43l92.s: H2 - Dynamic control value predicts allocation better than trivial baselines
1ijvn43l92.t: H2——动态控制价值对分配的预测优于平凡基线

ifbe106itv.t: 使用测得收益的联合资源模型，在预测留出用于评估的学习所得分配时，应优于：

26n72c52x0r.s: ⟦1⟧myopic value of computation (myopic VOC)⟦/1⟧ — define eligible increments of monitoring communication and select the increment with greatest ⟦2⟧one-step expected net improvement⟦/2⟧ in downstream decision quality, accounting for communication cost and the option to stop. Specify increment size, information updates and budget feasibility. Rate proportional to gross one-step value is a separate heuristic, not the canonical meta-greedy policy (Russell & Wefald 1991; Hay et al. 2012; Callaway et al. 2018).
26n72c52x0r.t: ⟦1⟧短视计算价值（myopic VOC）⟦/1⟧——定义监控通信的合格增量，并选择在下游决策质量上具有最大⟦2⟧一步期望净改进⟦/2⟧的增量，同时计入通信成本与停止选项。需明确增量大小、信息更新与预算可行性。与一步总价值成比例的速率是另一种启发式，而非标准的元贪婪策略（Russell & Wefald 1991；Hay et al. 2012；Callaway et al. 2018）。

p8lzq4lwtn.s: ⟦1⟧[Design addition, August 2026 — revised after release-candidate review]⟦/1⟧ Uniform allocation is a null; entropy-only, inferability-only and isolated-causal-value are ⟦2⟧simpler structured models⟦/2⟧, not nulls, and an earlier version wrongly lumped all five together. Myopic VOC is added because it is the closest competitor drawn from an established formalism, and because H4’s topology hypothesis ⟦3⟧overlaps conceptually⟦/3⟧ with value of computation — graph position is not identical to VOC, but the two are close enough that a topology result could be a VOC result in different notation. The comparator is specifically one-step value and is named as such: ⟦4⟧myopic VOC⟦/4⟧, one approximation within the metalevel-MDP framework, not VOC in general.
p8lzq4lwtn.t: ⟦1⟧[设计补充，2026年8月——经候选发布版评审后修订]⟦/1⟧ 均匀分配是一个零模型；仅熵、仅可推断性与孤立因果价值是⟦2⟧更简单的结构化模型⟦/2⟧，而非零模型，早先版本错误地将这五者混为一谈。加入短视 VOC，是因为它是源自既有形式体系的最接近的竞争者，也因为 H4 的拓扑假设与计算价值⟦3⟧在概念上有所重叠⟦/3⟧——图位置并不等同于 VOC，但二者足够接近，以至于一个拓扑结果可能只是换了记法的 VOC 结果。该比较模型专指一步价值，并如此命名：⟦4⟧短视 VOC⟦/4⟧，即元层级 MDP 框架中的一种近似，而非一般意义上的 VOC。

qwr17i351k.s: ⟦1⟧Against H2:⟦/1⟧ the richer resource model does not improve out-of-sample prediction over these baselines. ⟦2⟧If it fails specifically against myopic VOC⟦/2⟧, the honest reading is that a joint, budget-constrained resource surface adds nothing beyond myopic per-source value of computation. That is a clean, publishable negative result and it should be pre-registered as one.
qwr17i351k.t: ⟦1⟧反对 H2 的证据：⟦/1⟧更丰富的资源模型相对于这些基线并未改善样本外预测。⟦2⟧若它恰恰在与短视 VOC 的比较中失败⟦/2⟧，诚实的解读是：联合的、受预算约束的资源曲面在短视的逐来源计算价值之外没有带来任何增益。这是一个清晰、可发表的负面结果，应当作为负面结果进行预注册。

17oubf4x9ul.s: Selective corruption/replacement of ⟦1⟧ should impair the downstream behavior for which information about ⟦2⟧ is useful, while preserving non-target messages and remaining near trained support.
17oubf4x9ul.t: 对 ⟦1⟧ 的选择性损坏/替换，应会损害那些需要借助 ⟦2⟧ 相关信息的下游行为，同时保留非目标消息，并保持在训练支撑集附近。

1bybyazj8fh.s: ⟦1⟧Against H3:⟦/1⟧ ⟦2⟧ is decodable from ⟦3⟧ but removing/corrupting ⟦4⟧ has no relevant behavioral effect.
1bybyazj8fh.t: ⟦1⟧反对 H3 的证据：⟦/1⟧⟦2⟧ 可从 ⟦3⟧ 中解码，但移除/损坏 ⟦4⟧ 并未产生相关的行为效应。

2i3z1etumc.s: H4 - Topology is a candidate secondary predictor
2i3z1etumc.t: H4——拓扑是一个候选的次级预测因子

1i3spz26an.s: If technically feasible, vary or measure downstream reach/persistence and test whether these properties improve prediction beyond direct causal value and inferability.
1i3spz26an.t: 若技术上可行，则改变或测量下游的影响范围/持续性，并检验这些属性能否在直接因果价值与可推断性之外提升预测。

2gopik7iqm0.s: This is secondary. It should not endanger completion of H1-H3.
2gopik7iqm0.t: 这是次要部分。它不应危及 H1-H3 的完成。

34wbjsal3z.s: ⟦1⟧Direct-read oracle.⟦/1⟧ Give the coordinator direct access to selected private states to estimate the ceiling and verify that hidden-state information can help.

1ylmtianxoq.s: ⟦1⟧No-seam/full-read control.⟦/1⟧ Confirm that the communication problem is generated by restricted access rather than the task alone.
1ylmtianxoq.t: ⟦1⟧无接缝/完全读取对照。⟦/1⟧确认通信问题是由受限访问而非仅由任务本身所产生的。

r5lp6xxn56.s: ⟦1⟧Non-binding capacity condition.⟦/1⟧ All candidate heads must be capable of becoming informative before scarcity is imposed.

2dwhj8s7wm5.s: ⟦1⟧Allocation plateau.⟦/1⟧ Measure confirmatory rates only after budget, return and rate trajectories stabilize by a preregistered rule.
2dwhj8s7wm5.t: ⟦1⟧分配平台期。⟦/1⟧仅在预算、回报与速率轨迹按预注册的规则趋于稳定之后，才测量验证性速率。

18v3wl8ahvc.s: ⟦1⟧Held-out environments/contingencies.⟦/1⟧ The allocation model should predict more than the exact configurations used to fit it.
18v3wl8ahvc.t: ⟦1⟧留出用于评估的环境/情境。⟦/1⟧分配模型应能预测的不仅仅是用于拟合它的那些确切配置。

8punyv3ekz.s: These controls are the scientific core. They are more important than decorative model complexity.
8punyv3ekz.t: 这些对照是科学核心。它们比装饰性的模型复杂度更为重要。

yyl4i2n1i9.s: 7. What is deliberately excluded from the core thesis →
yyl4i2n1i9.t: 7. 核心论文刻意排除的内容 →

24jinj8ii8r.s: The earlier Sīdus question asked whether attention received excess rate relative to a resource baseline. In the new programme, attention is one source among others. Generic residuals may be inspected, but the thesis does not depend on a special attention effect.
24jinj8ii8r.t: 早先的 Sīdus 问题曾问：相对于资源基线，注意是否获得了过量的速率。在新的研究计划中，注意只是众多来源之一。可以检查一般性的残差，但本论文并不依赖于某种特殊的注意效应。

spx9ft8ii6.t: 不作严格元表征的主张

2cat86aw69k.s: The messages in this experiment are ⟦1⟧internal-state models⟦/1⟧. That terminology avoids pretending the project has already solved the contested definition of metarepresentation.
2cat86aw69k.t: 本实验中的消息是⟦1⟧内部状态模型⟦/1⟧。这一术语避免了假装本项目已经解决元表征这一有争议的定义问题。

a5bsqgrkk0.s: Interchange-intervention/causal-abstraction analysis is elegant but high overhead. Use it only if a robust role-dependent effect has already been established and the high-level role claim materially matters.
a5bsqgrkk0.t: 互换干预/因果抽象分析虽然优雅，但开销很大。仅当某个稳健的角色依赖效应已经确立，且高层角色主张确实至关重要时，才使用它。

12fi9d4vc4j.s: No Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization by default
12fi9d4vc4j.t: 默认不使用高斯过程贝叶斯优化

6eik7jpxdo.s: Start with a small factorial/simplex design. Escalate to Astrocyte only if training evaluations become sufficiently expensive that active surface estimation is justified.
6eik7jpxdo.t: 先从小型析因/单纯形设计入手。仅当训练评估的代价高到足以证明主动曲面估计合理时，才升级到 Astrocyte。

10mhkhc8vts.s: A human study should not be added as a thesis appendix merely to make the work look neuroscientific. Biological translation becomes meaningful after construct validity and a reproducible computational phenomenon exist.
10mhkhc8vts.t: 不应仅为使工作显得具有神经科学色彩而将一项人类研究作为论文附录加入。只有在构念效度和一个可复现的计算现象确立之后，生物学转化才具有意义。

20yfpwgltzv.t: 11. 准备情况与先修知识缺口 →

1ko15rd6mzq.s: Assess preparation individually, whether entry is direct or involves a bridging programme. Relevant foundations are programming, calculus, linear algebra, probability and statistics, followed by machine learning, reinforcement learning and computational cognition.
1ko15rd6mzq.t: 无论是直接入学还是经由衔接项目入学，都应对准备情况进行个别评估。相关基础依次为编程、微积分、线性代数、概率与统计，其后是机器学习、强化学习和计算认知。

1jj1aqlf20u.s: Use small implementations to identify gaps before expanding the research environment. A particular admissions pathway or named preparatory course is not a scientific assumption of the thesis.
1jj1aqlf20u.t: 在扩展研究环境之前，先用小型实现找出知识缺口。特定的录取途径或指定的预备课程并非本论文的科学假设。

cxnyunzcga.t: 12. 研究组与导师的契合度 →

157mlmgo3el.s: Look for experience with learned agents, probabilistic models, representation learning or computational neuroscience, plus sufficient compute and time for independent runs and intervention checks. Complete simulator access is essential during the synthetic phase; a biological dataset is not required.
157mlmgo3el.t: 寻找在习得智能体、概率模型、表征学习或计算神经科学方面有经验的指导，并确保有足够的算力和时间进行独立运行和干预检验。在合成阶段，完整的模拟器访问权限必不可少；不需要生物学数据集。

1li333pfud.t: 形式与对抗性方面的支持

13972z5mmh9.s: Look for supervision that can challenge the construct, assess identifiability and computational tractability, and demand comparisons with established communication, control and metareasoning models. Computational modelling should force theoretical commitments to become testable; relevant methodological precedents include Guest & Martin and van Rooij & Baggio. [1,2]
13972z5mmh9.t: 寻找能够质疑构念、评估可识别性与计算可处理性，并要求与已有的通信、控制及元推理模型进行比较的指导。计算建模应迫使理论承诺变得可检验；相关的方法论先例包括 Guest & Martin 以及 van Rooij & Baggio。[1,2]

yblyqvffpu.s: One supervisor or a complementary supervisory team may provide this combination. Confirm actual interest and availability rather than inferring them from a lab label. The project fits a host through its methods and question, not through an institutional affiliation.
yblyqvffpu.t: 这一组合可以由一位导师或一个互补的指导团队提供。应确认对方的实际兴趣和时间安排，而不是从实验室标签加以推断。本项目与所在单位的契合在于方法和问题，而非机构隶属关系。

bm42ns93k.s: The Master’s should end with one of two conclusions.
bm42ns93k.t: 硕士研究应以以下两种结论之一作结。

1lemgvgpcgd.s: Under controlled partial access and a binding information-rate constraint, learned internal-state monitoring exhibits a reproducible allocation principle that survives simpler baselines and causal-use tests. This justifies testing whether the same principle applies to stricter metarepresentations or other architectures.
1lemgvgpcgd.t: 在受控的部分访问和具有约束力的信息速率约束下，习得的内部状态监控表现出一种可复现的分配原则，且该原则能够经受住更简单基线和因果使用检验的考验。这为检验同一原则是否适用于更严格的元表征或其他架构提供了正当理由。

ebv11bb9b7.s: The tested scarcity formulation does not produce a stable/generalizable allocation principle, or its effects reduce to simpler inferability, implementation or optimization factors. The broader programme should not treat scarcity as an organizing law without a different empirical basis.
ebv11bb9b7.t: 所检验的稀缺表述未能产生稳定或可推广的分配原则，或者其效应可归结为更简单的可推断性、实现或优化因素。在没有不同经验基础的情况下，更广泛的研究计划不应将稀缺视为一条组织性定律。

hz66r3eehb.s: The inequality ⟦1⟧ was previously asserted as a property of “the intended variational construction.” It is in fact an identity plus a non-negative term, and writing it out converts a qualitative diagnostic into two estimable numbers.
hz66r3eehb.t: 不等式⟦1⟧此前被断言为“预期的变分构造”的一项性质。实际上，它是一个恒等式加上一个非负项；将其完整写出，可把一项定性诊断转化为两个可估计的数值。

1zvfwieitl2.s: ⟦1⟧[Revised after release-candidate review.]⟦/1⟧ The mismatch term is an expectation over ⟦2⟧, not a bare divergence. ⟦3⟧ is a function of the random variable ⟦4⟧; only its expectation is the scalar that completes the identity. Because this is stated as an identity it has to be exact, and an implementation that omits the average would compute a per-timestep quantity and mis-report it.
1zvfwieitl2.t: ⟦1⟧[在候选发布版审阅后修订。]⟦/1⟧失配项是对⟦2⟧的期望，而非单纯的散度。⟦3⟧是随机变量⟦4⟧的函数；只有其期望才是使恒等式成立的标量。由于这被表述为恒等式，它必须是精确的；若实现中省略了取平均这一步，就会计算出逐时间步的量并错误地报告它。

1g6v9hta7qw.s: ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧ is robust, not an assumption.⟦/1⟧ It holds for any prior, learned or fixed. Finite-sample estimates may still violate it; the population statement does not depend on the encoder having been trained well.
1g6v9hta7qw.t: ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧是稳健的，而非一项假设。⟦/1⟧它对任何先验（无论是习得的还是固定的）均成立。有限样本估计仍可能违反它；该总体层面的陈述并不依赖于编码器是否训练良好。

i7zelr9zka.s: ⟦1⟧The Gate A4 signature decomposes exactly.⟦/1⟧ The pattern ⟦2⟧ — recorded there as “possible redundant coding, inefficient optimization, or target-metric mismatch” — separates cleanly: the rate is spent on ⟦3⟧, i.e. mismatch between the aggregate posterior ⟦4⟧ and the prior, rather than on information about ⟦5⟧. Estimate ⟦6⟧ directly and report it; do not infer it by subtraction alone.
i7zelr9zka.t: ⟦1⟧关卡 A4 的特征模式可被精确分解。⟦/1⟧模式⟦2⟧（在该处被记录为“可能的冗余编码、低效优化或目标–度量失配”）可以被清晰地拆分：速率被消耗在⟦3⟧上，即聚合后验⟦4⟧与先验之间的失配，而非关于⟦5⟧的信息。应直接估计并报告⟦6⟧；不要仅凭相减来推断它。

1l5hok0eer9.s: ⟦1⟧It answers the “soft penalty with extra steps” objection.⟦/1⟧ With a ⟦2⟧learned⟦/2⟧ prior fitted to the aggregate posterior, ⟦3⟧ shrinks and the variational surrogate tightens toward the true conditional information. The surrogate’s looseness is therefore a measurable quantity rather than an unknown, which is what licenses using it as a rate meter at all. It does ⟦4⟧not⟦/4⟧, on its own, establish that a trained run satisfies the shared constraint — see Arm S’s realised-violation feasibility diagnostic in Document II, §10. The alphabet arm there is optional currency-sensitivity work, not a requirement for E1.
1l5hok0eer9.t: ⟦1⟧它回应了“不过是多绕几步的软惩罚”这一反对意见。⟦/1⟧若采用拟合于聚合后验的⟦2⟧习得⟦/2⟧先验，⟦3⟧会缩小，变分替代量会向真实条件信息收紧。因此，替代量的松弛程度是一个可测量的量，而非未知量，这正是它之所以能够被用作速率计的依据。但它本身并⟦4⟧不⟦/4⟧能证明一次训练运行满足共享约束——参见文档 II §10 中 Arm S 的实际违约可行性诊断。该处的字母表分支属于可选的“货币”敏感性研究，并非 E1 的必要条件。

1xuwfekutle.s: Pass only if, under a non-binding communication condition:
1xuwfekutle.t: 仅当在非约束性通信条件下满足以下各项时方为通过：

1zyv9dbcsjx.s: exact ⟦1⟧, or a validated estimate with approximation and sampling uncertainty accounted for, is meaningfully above zero;
1zyv9dbcsjx.t: 精确的⟦1⟧，或已计入近似不确定性与抽样不确定性的经验证估计值，显著大于零；

29ksg87o9qu.s: ⟦1⟧ and the encoder has not collapsed;

dp32hnsm0.s: performance approaches the direct-read ceiling enough to show that the channel can solve the intended information problem.
dp32hnsm0.t: 性能足够接近直接读取上限，足以表明该信道能够解决预期的信息问题。

2e1j8of0upa.s: ← 2. Gate A1 - Residual hiddenness and potential value
2e1j8of0upa.t: ← 2. 关卡 A1 - 残余隐蔽性与潜在价值

24uas75cqyu.t: 4. 关卡 A3 - 选择性因果使用 →

1was1ffa529.t: 4.1 支撑集内的反事实置乱

16njr0vwigo.s: Replace the actual message with a valid message associated with an alternative reachable controller state:
16njr0vwigo.t: 将实际消息替换为与另一可达控制器状态相关联的有效消息：

1m5w784u8ja.s: Require ⟦1⟧ to be reachable conditional on the same ⟦2⟧, and verify replacement-message support conditional on all other inputs held fixed at the consumer, including non-target messages. Marginal familiarity of a message is insufficient. Record the eligible intervention population and use paired draws or replay with non-target state and randomness held fixed where appropriate. If no eligible alternative exists, report ⟦3⟧not applicable⟦/3⟧ for that intervention; do not substitute a zero effect or count it as a pass. Avoid arbitrary zeroing unless zero is a trained, conditionally supported message state.
1m5w784u8ja.t: 要求⟦1⟧在相同⟦2⟧的条件下可达，并在消费者处其他所有输入（包括非目标消息）保持固定的条件下，验证替换消息位于支撑集内。仅凭消息在边际意义上常见是不够的。记录符合条件的干预总体，并在适当情况下使用配对抽样或重放，同时保持非目标状态与随机性固定。若不存在符合条件的替代项，则对该干预报告⟦3⟧不适用⟦/3⟧；不得以零效应代替，也不得将其计为通过。除非零是经过训练且在条件意义上受支撑的消息状态，否则应避免任意置零。

1732bzn3uwo.s: Measure the ⟦1⟧proximal decision or policy variable⟦/1⟧ predicted to depend on ⟦2⟧, not only total episode return.
1732bzn3uwo.t: 测量预测依赖于⟦2⟧的⟦1⟧近端决策或策略变量⟦/1⟧，而不仅仅是回合总回报。

hlqpxqx90m.s: Total return ⟦1⟧ is secondary when downstream compensation could mask a genuine local causal effect. This intervention estimates the existing consumer’s dependence on its message. It is distinct from the achievable task-value difference between matched consumers with and without the channel, and from exact Bayes informational headroom. Report these estimands separately: a consumer can rely on redundant information.
hlqpxqx90m.t: 当下游补偿可能掩盖真实的局部因果效应时，总回报⟦1⟧仅为次要指标。该干预估计的是现有消费者对其消息的依赖程度。它不同于有信道与无信道的匹配消费者之间可实现的任务价值差异，也不同于精确贝叶斯信息提升空间。应分别报告这些估计量：消费者可能依赖冗余信息。

24nvbmueewg.s: At the intervention time or within a preregistered proximal window, verify that non-target quantities remain approximately intact:
24nvbmueewg.t: 在干预时刻或预注册的近端窗口内，验证非目标量大致保持不变：

2f56wxj4no8.s: Later downstream changes caused by the intervention are legitimate causal consequences and should not be misclassified as intervention leakage.
2f56wxj4no8.t: 由干预引起的后续下游变化属于正当的因果后果，不应被误判为干预泄漏。

12xm9pn1dev.s: the on-support message intervention causes the predicted local downstream change;
12xm9pn1dev.t: 支撑集内的消息干预引起了预测的局部下游变化；

1nu7xgj3zjg.s: the effect exceeds a preregistered minimally meaningful threshold, not merely a significance threshold;
1nu7xgj3zjg.t: 效应超过预注册的最小有意义阈值，而不仅仅是显著性阈值；

1voeemp15xc.s: first-order/private target execution is preserved at intervention time;
1voeemp15xc.t: 一阶/私有目标的执行在干预时刻得以保持；

1vt34zq8ze7.s: non-target channels are preserved over the specified proximal window.
1vt34zq8ze7.t: 非目标信道在指定的近端窗口内得以保持。

1oyjllpxzul.t: 5. 关卡 A4 - 捷径敏感性 →

2cokk9p1k9.s: E0-A should demonstrate that the special monitoring channel is valuable ⟦1⟧because information is missing⟦/1⟧, not merely because the architecture has learned to use an arbitrary extra input.
2cokk9p1k9.t: E0-A 应证明，专用监控信道之所以有价值，是⟦1⟧因为信息缺失⟦/1⟧，而不仅仅是因为架构学会了利用一个任意的额外输入。

jim0hy0oa6.s: Construct legitimate environment conditions that vary the public inferability of ⟦1⟧:
jim0hy0oa6.t: 构建正当的环境条件，以改变⟦1⟧的公共可推断性：

i86tb96ndp.s: The manipulation must reveal the task-relevant information supplied by the message, not merely an unrelated component of ⟦1⟧. Reduced hiddenness alone gives only the bound
i86tb96ndp.t: 该操纵必须揭示由消息提供的任务相关信息，而不仅仅是⟦1⟧中某个无关的分量。仅降低隐蔽性只能给出以下界限

wf54z9cx5p.s: not a general monotonicity law for message information or benefit. For independent fair bits ⟦1⟧, message ⟦2⟧, and a task requiring ⟦3⟧, revealing ⟦4⟧ reduces hiddenness from two bits to one while message information stays at one bit and optimal accuracy gain stays at 50 percentage points. Exact estimation exposes this counterexample; it does not repair the prediction.
wf54z9cx5p.t: 而非关于消息信息或收益的一般单调性规律。对于独立的公平比特⟦1⟧、消息⟦2⟧以及需要⟦3⟧的任务，揭示⟦4⟧会使隐蔽性从两个比特降至一个比特，而消息信息仍为一个比特，最优准确率增益仍为 50 个百分点。精确估计能够揭示这一反例，但并不能修正该预测。

2ankjaxl6l5.s: Preregister a task-specific observability manipulation and establish its predicted effect using the exact reference before testing the learned system. Name three separate estimands: incremental information ⟦1⟧; matched achievable message benefit (with exact Bayes headroom reported separately); and the existing consumer’s proximal dependence under A3. Do not use corruption sensitivity as a substitute for informational benefit.
2ankjaxl6l5.t: 预注册一项针对具体任务的可观测性操纵，并在测试习得系统之前，利用精确参照确定其预测效应。明确三个相互独立的估计量：增量信息⟦1⟧；匹配的可实现消息收益（另行报告精确贝叶斯提升空间）；以及 A3 下现有消费者的近端依赖。不得以扰动敏感性替代信息收益。

153bnmbq7s2.s: Full observability remains a valid endpoint for exact information and public-only performance. The alternative-state intervention stops where its conditional-support requirement fails; mark that endpoint ⟦1⟧not applicable⟦/1⟧ for the intervention rather than failed or zero. Define the eligible range before confirmatory evaluation and report how the eligible population changes across the sweep.
153bnmbq7s2.t: 完全可观测性仍是精确信息与仅公共信息性能的有效端点。替代状态干预在其条件支撑要求不再成立之处终止；应将该端点标记为干预⟦1⟧不适用⟦/1⟧，而非未通过或零。在验证性评估之前界定符合条件的范围，并报告符合条件的总体在整个扫描过程中如何变化。

1xv6jm5d7r3.s: Do ⟦1⟧not⟦/1⟧ require ⟦2⟧ in the absence of a channel cost. Redundant coding can persist even when incremental information vanishes.
1xv6jm5d7r3.t: 在不存在信道成本的情况下，⟦1⟧不⟦/1⟧要求⟦2⟧。即使增量信息消失，冗余编码仍可能持续存在。

2gldu8zmvzx.s: If an explicit message cost is imposed, then efficient learning additionally predicts:
2gldu8zmvzx.t: 若施加显式的消息成本，则高效学习还会预测：

hjrbqm6zrz.s: should be recorded as possible redundant coding, inefficient optimization, or target-metric mismatch rather than defined away.
hjrbqm6zrz.t: 应被记录为可能的冗余编码、低效优化或目标指标失配，而不应通过定义将其排除。

13l008ec5m6.s: Pass only if incremental information and matched achievable message benefit decline by the preregistered meaningful amounts under the validated task-relevant observability manipulation. Report confidence intervals and approximation uncertainty; any ratio criterion must be preregistered and never evaluated using bare ratios of point estimates. Report A3 consumer dependence separately over its eligible support range. Failed support or unresolved measurement uncertainty cannot be silently converted into a passing result.
13l008ec5m6.t: 仅当在经验证的任务相关可观测性操纵下，增量信息与匹配的可实现消息收益按预注册的有意义幅度下降时方为通过。报告置信区间与近似不确定性；任何比率判据都必须预注册，且绝不能使用点估计的简单比率进行评估。在其符合条件的支撑范围内单独报告 A3 消费者依赖。支撑失效或未解决的测量不确定性不得被悄然转化为通过结果。

xl3798vfua.s: 5A. Non-gating diagnostic - cross-source leakage must be measured conditionally →
xl3798vfua.t: 5A. 非关卡诊断 - 跨源泄漏必须以条件方式测量 →

qcaxo9hlrq.t: [R3 · 更正，2026 年 8 月审阅轮次——预防性]

82nog8yb5c.s: No cross-source independence check appears in the protocol above. Earlier working sketches used an unconditional mutual information ⟦1⟧ as a “cheating” diagnostic, and any future implementation is likely to reach for the same quantity. It is the wrong one, and the error is silent.
82nog8yb5c.t: 上述协议中并未包含跨源独立性检验。早期的工作草稿曾使用无条件互信息⟦1⟧作为“作弊”诊断，而未来的任何实现很可能会沿用同一个量。这个量是错误的，而且这一错误不会显现出来。

gkvmqb0m0k.s: Sources that share public context will exhibit ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧legitimately⟦/2⟧, because both messages are conditioned on ⟦3⟧. An unconditional test therefore flags correct architectures as leaking. The right quantity conditions on the public information the consumer already holds:
gkvmqb0m0k.t: 共享公共语境的信源会⟦2⟧正当地⟦/2⟧表现出⟦1⟧，因为两条消息都以⟦3⟧为条件。因此，无条件检验会将正确的架构误判为存在泄漏。正确的量应以消费者已掌握的公共信息为条件：

upspx3br36.s: and for ⟦1⟧ sources, the total correlation given ⟦2⟧:
upspx3br36.t: 对于⟦1⟧个信源，则为给定⟦2⟧时的全相关：

2dpynzdc20j.s: Non-zero conditional dependence is still not automatically a fault: encoders may legitimately coordinate under a shared budget.
2dpynzdc20j.t: 非零的条件依赖仍不自动构成故障：编码器可能在共享预算下进行正当的协调。

q20s9i7tid.s: ⟦1⟧[Revised after release-candidate review.]⟦/1⟧ An earlier version named the fault condition as ⟦2⟧. That is still too strong. If the sources are conditionally dependent,
q20s9i7tid.t: ⟦1⟧[经候选发布版审阅后修订。]⟦/1⟧早期版本将故障条件定为⟦2⟧。这仍然过强。若各信源在条件意义上相互依赖，

r17khsfzyf.s: then ⟦1⟧ forms a chain given ⟦2⟧, so ⟦3⟧ carries information about ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧indirectly and legitimately⟦/5⟧, even though encoder ⟦6⟧ never saw ⟦7⟧. By data processing, ⟦8⟧, which is positive whenever the sources are dependent. Flagging that as leakage would condemn a correct architecture.
r17khsfzyf.t: 则给定⟦2⟧时⟦1⟧构成一条链，因此即使编码器⟦6⟧从未见过⟦7⟧，⟦3⟧也会⟦5⟧间接且正当地⟦/5⟧携带关于⟦4⟧的信息。由数据处理不等式，⟦8⟧，只要信源相互依赖，该值即为正。将其标记为泄漏会错误地否定一个正确的架构。

2aiz3alag8d.s: The diagnostic that isolates unauthorised access conditions on the source the encoder is entitled to see:
2aiz3alag8d.t: 能够分离出未授权访问的诊断，应以编码器有权看到的信源为条件：

15q29f4rqju.s: Under the intended factorised architecture ⟦1⟧, this quantity vanishes exactly, absent shared private randomness or another forbidden path. Non-zero values indicate that encoder ⟦2⟧ has access it should not have — which is the quantity that would break the per-source attribution on which Gate A3, Gate A4 and hypothesis H3 all depend.
15q29f4rqju.t: 在预期的因子化架构⟦1⟧下，若不存在共享的私有随机性或其他被禁止的路径，该量恰好为零。非零值表明编码器⟦2⟧拥有其不应具有的访问权限——而这正是会破坏逐信源归因的量，关卡 A3、关卡 A4 与假设 H3 均依赖于这种归因。

259bakp4ofu.s: Report ⟦1⟧ alongside it. Source dependence sets how much legitimate cross-decodability to expect, and without it the conditional test has no reference scale.
259bakp4ofu.t: 同时报告⟦1⟧。信源依赖决定了应预期多少正当的交叉可解码性；没有它，条件检验便缺乏参照尺度。

1j12cpuwj0h.s: Finally, prefer architecture to inference. The access restriction should be ⟦1⟧enforced in code⟦/1⟧ — encoder ⟦2⟧ is wired to receive only ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ — and these information quantities used as ⟦5⟧manipulation checks on that wiring⟦/5⟧, not as a method for inferring architecture from mutual information alone.
1j12cpuwj0h.t: 最后，应优先依靠架构而非推断。访问限制应⟦1⟧在代码中强制实施⟦/1⟧——编码器⟦2⟧的连接方式使其仅接收⟦3⟧与⟦4⟧——而这些信息量应作为针对该连接的⟦5⟧操纵检验⟦/5⟧，而非仅凭互信息推断架构的方法。

mncuf4ropt.t: ← 5. 关卡 A4 - 捷径敏感性

7l1dp4frmp.s: E0-A licenses E1 scarcity only when all four gates pass across independent seeds. The cross-source leakage diagnostic in §5A is recommended and reportable when relevant, but it does ⟦1⟧not⟦/1⟧ constitute a fifth gate:
7l1dp4frmp.t: 仅当全部四个关卡在各独立种子上均通过时，E0-A 才准许进行 E1 稀缺实验。§5A 中的跨源泄漏诊断为建议项，在相关时可予报告，但它⟦1⟧并不⟦/1⟧构成第五个关卡：

1q8e5t4frln.t: A1 - 残余隐蔽性 + 提升空间

opwnqidkzl.s: public information leaves non-trivial uncertainty and direct-read information can improve relevant behavior
opwnqidkzl.t: 公共信息留下了不可忽略的不确定性，且直接读取的信息能够改善相关行为

v8blgw5u6e.s: non-binding channel transmits additional target information and avoids collapse
v8blgw5u6e.t: 非约束性通道传递额外的目标信息，并避免坍缩

t2ukbbc18a.s: on-support message intervention produces the predicted local downstream effect with proximal non-target preservation
t2ukbbc18a.t: 支持集内的消息干预产生所预测的局部下游效应，同时保持近端非目标不变

26l6fdyg6or.s: a validated task-relevant observability manipulation reduces incremental information and matched achievable message benefit; consumer dependence and support eligibility are reported separately
26l6fdyg6or.t: 经验证的、与任务相关的可观测性操纵会降低增量信息以及匹配的可实现消息收益；消费者依赖性与支持集资格分别报告

13zp2aqe4el.s: Report ⟦1⟧pass, fail, or inconclusive⟦/1⟧ for each gate under a preregistered seed/precision rule. ⟦2⟧Not applicable⟦/2⟧ labels a particular unsupported intervention, not successful gate evidence. E1 is licensed only when A1-A4 pass; a false positive on A1/A2 alone is not a demonstrated false pass of E0-A. If a gate fails or remains inconclusive, do not proceed as if the construct were intact. Re-engineer the task, simplify the channel, or revise the claim.
13zp2aqe4el.t: 在预注册的种子/精度规则下，对每个关卡报告⟦1⟧通过、未通过或无定论⟦/1⟧。⟦2⟧不适用⟦/2⟧标记的是某一特定的不受支持的干预，而非关卡成功的证据。仅当 A1-A4 全部通过时，才可进入 E1；仅在 A1/A2 上出现的假阳性，并不构成已被证实的 E0-A 错误通过。若某一关卡未通过或仍无定论，不得在假定构念完好的情况下继续推进。应重新设计任务、简化通道或修正主张。

199q8uk4zoh.s: ← 5A. Non-gating diagnostic - cross-source leakage must be measured conditionally
199q8uk4zoh.t: ← 5A. 非关卡性诊断——跨来源泄漏必须以条件方式测量

hsklmv3kkv.s: E0-B is deliberately less mature than E0-A.
hsklmv3kkv.t: E0-B 有意设计得不如 E0-A 成熟。

1owb6ei7j76.s: Its purpose is not to settle the philosophy of metarepresentation. It asks whether a synthetic experiment can distinguish a candidate ⟦1⟧property/process metarepresentation⟦/1⟧ from simpler alternatives under explicitly stated operational criteria.
1owb6ei7j76.t: 其目的并非解决元表征的哲学问题。它所探究的是：在明确陈述的操作性标准下，合成实验能否将候选的⟦1⟧属性/过程元表征⟦/1⟧与更简单的替代方案区分开来。

1gg7wp36ejk.s: ⟦1⟧[Second external review pass — design commitment executed.]⟦/1⟧ E0-B is not run under a single chosen definition. The three criteria of Document I §2.3 disagree in principle, so the protocol is ⟦2⟧definition-indexed⟦/2⟧:
1gg7wp36ejk.t: ⟦1⟧[第二轮外部评审——设计承诺已执行。]⟦/1⟧E0-B 并非在单一选定的定义下运行。文档 I §2.3 中的三条标准在原则上相互分歧，因此该方案是⟦2⟧按定义索引的⟦/2⟧：

1ulr8p3lyps.s: run over the same architectures, preregistered manipulations and evidence tiers. A system may satisfy one operationalization and fail another. That outcome is not experimental failure. If the criteria repeatedly carve systems differently, the warranted conclusion is that ⟦1⟧“metarepresentation” does not yet behave as one empirically unified construct⟦/1⟧, and the programme should then speak specifically of representational-property monitoring, process representation, or representational redescription — whichever actually survived — rather than of metarepresentation simpliciter.
1ulr8p3lyps.t: 在相同的架构、预注册的操纵和证据层级上运行。一个系统可能满足一种操作化定义而不满足另一种。这一结果并非实验失败。如果这些标准反复以不同方式划分系统，则有据的结论是⟦1⟧“元表征”尚未表现为一个在经验上统一的构念⟦/1⟧；此时，该研究计划应具体地谈论表征属性监控、过程表征或表征重述——以实际经受住检验者为准——而不是笼统地谈论元表征本身。

2deg8ecwcvt.s: Before confirmatory use, each index requires a distinct executable predicate, named counterexamples and controls showing which architectures can satisfy one index while failing another. The shared discriminators below are necessary design scaffolding, not three completed definitions.
2deg8ecwcvt.t: 在用于验证性分析之前，每个索引都需要一个独立的可执行谓词、具名的反例，以及能表明哪些架构可以满足某一索引而不满足另一索引的对照。下文共享的判别项是必要的设计支架，而非三个已完成的定义。

il7g7igbvm.s: For ⟦1⟧Shea⟦/1⟧, specify the representational property entering the candidate’s correctness conditions and a consumer that uses it as such. For ⟦2⟧RR⟦/2⟧, test a preregistered gain in accessibility to a bounded consumer, with explicit first-order redescription, consumer-role and matched feature-transformation controls; accessibility gain alone is ordinary feature engineering as well. For ⟦3⟧Process⟦/3⟧, require evidence about the generating mapping beyond a scalar reliability cue, using held-out process interventions and matched simpler process-state monitors. These are operational commitments to refine against Proust, Shea, Cleeremans/SOMA and process-metarepresentation work, not claims to exhaust those accounts.
il7g7igbvm.t: 对于⟦1⟧Shea⟦/1⟧，须明确进入候选者正确性条件的表征属性，以及将其作为该属性加以使用的消费者。对于⟦2⟧RR⟦/2⟧，须检验资源有限的消费者在可及性上的预注册增益，并设置明确的一阶重述对照、消费者角色对照以及匹配的特征变换对照；仅凭可及性增益，同样也可能只是普通的特征工程。对于⟦3⟧过程⟦/3⟧，须要求提供超出标量可靠性线索的、关于生成映射的证据，方法是使用留出用于评估的过程干预以及匹配的更简单过程状态监控器。这些是需对照 Proust、Shea、Cleeremans/SOMA 及过程元表征相关研究加以完善的操作性承诺，而非宣称已穷尽这些理论。

1x4bpwh28nm.s: Specify exactly which inputs, history, parameters, training data and computational capacity B0/B1 receive. A bounded shortcut predictor is not equivalent to conditioning on complete first-order activity. If ⟦1⟧ is a deterministic redescription of that activity, it adds no Shannon information beyond its complete inputs; it may nevertheless improve bounded-consumer accessibility. Report that accessibility separately from absolute conditional information.
1x4bpwh28nm.t: 须精确说明 B0/B1 所接收的输入、历史、参数、训练数据和计算能力。资源有限的捷径预测器并不等同于以完整的一阶活动为条件。如果⟦1⟧是该活动的确定性重述，则它在其完整输入之外不增加任何香农信息；但它仍可能提升资源有限的消费者的可及性。应将这种可及性与绝对条件信息分开报告。

1z2sgh94jyz.s: Let an external latent state ⟦1⟧ generate observation ⟦2⟧. A first-order system produces:
1z2sgh94jyz.t: 设外部潜在状态⟦1⟧生成观测⟦2⟧。一阶系统产生：

2beldkyh24g.s: where ⟦1⟧ controls a hidden property of the representational process, for example:
2beldkyh24g.t: 其中⟦1⟧控制表征过程的某一隐藏属性，例如：

1lagiltblh2.s: Construct at least three comparison systems:
1lagiltblh2.t: 构建至少三个比较系统：

1eokj24qzf0.s: Predicts the task target or ⟦1⟧ from public context, observation, or ordinary downstream activity without an explicit model of a representational property/process.
1eokj24qzf0.t: 根据公共语境、观测或普通的下游活动预测任务目标或⟦1⟧，而不对表征属性/过程进行显式建模。

1gd1uahko21.s: Represents a private controller/process state ⟦1⟧, but is not required to represent a property of ⟦2⟧ or the process ⟦3⟧.
1gd1uahko21.t: 表征私有的控制器/过程状态⟦1⟧，但不要求表征⟦2⟧的属性或过程⟦3⟧。

1bx46cgn7xw.t: B2 - 候选属性/过程元表征

1g6n963wcry.s: Produces a state ⟦1⟧ whose task-relevant target is explicitly:
1g6n963wcry.t: 产生状态⟦1⟧，其与任务相关的目标明确为：

18xa99bd97w.s: where ⟦1⟧ may be reliability, source, correctness probability, or another preregistered representational property.
18xa99bd97w.t: 其中⟦1⟧可以是可靠性、来源、正确概率或其他预注册的表征属性。

15n1dxthfj1.s: E0-B should not pass merely because ⟦1⟧ decodes ⟦2⟧.
15n1dxthfj1.t: E0-B 不应仅因⟦1⟧能解码⟦2⟧而通过。

1kkkqwnff2q.s: At minimum, the design should include matched conditions that:
1kkkqwnff2q.t: 设计至少应包含满足以下要求的匹配条件：

dkz8v9f1v0.s: hold external target ⟦1⟧ fixed while ⟦2⟧ changes;
dkz8v9f1v0.t: 在⟦2⟧变化时保持外部目标⟦1⟧固定；

aohuqk368l.s: hold first-order choice/output fixed while reliability/source/process regime changes where feasible;
aohuqk368l.t: 在可行时，于可靠性/来源/过程模式变化时保持一阶选择/输出固定；

1zzzeqpu2wt.s: include cases in which ⟦1⟧ can misrepresent its target;
1zzzeqpu2wt.t: 纳入⟦1⟧可能错误表征其目标的情形；

1e4va7mo98n.s: compare against a public-context shortcut with matched capacity;
1e4va7mo98n.t: 与容量匹配的公共语境捷径进行比较；

qdi8czcu8z.s: perturb the target property/process and test whether ⟦1⟧ changes as predicted;
qdi8czcu8z.t: 扰动目标属性/过程，并检验⟦1⟧是否按预测发生变化；

6ryuzs3j6j.s: perturb ⟦1⟧ while preserving the first-order representation and test whether its intended consumer changes appropriately.
6ryuzs3j6j.t: 在保持一阶表征不变的情况下扰动⟦1⟧，并检验其预期消费者是否发生相应变化。

xyr9x7uhn1.s: E0-B passes ⟦1⟧for the selected operational definition only⟦/1⟧ if the candidate B2 architecture:
xyr9x7uhn1.t: 若候选 B2 架构满足以下条件，则 E0-B ⟦1⟧仅就所选操作性定义而言⟦/1⟧通过：

w7c9cx2xsh.s: satisfies the preregistered index-specific specificity or bounded-accessibility predicate, with explicit B0/B1 inputs and capacity controls; information and accessibility are reported as different estimands;
w7c9cx2xsh.t: 满足预注册的、特定于索引的特异性谓词或资源有限可及性谓词，并对 B0/B1 的输入与容量设置明确对照；信息与可及性作为不同的估计量分别报告；

1zqk5hsa2at.s: can dissociate from the first-order output and can misrepresent its meta-target;
1zqk5hsa2at.t: 能够与一阶输出相分离，并可能错误表征其元目标；

340y1hsm70.s: responds selectively to intervention on the target representational property/process;
340y1hsm70.t: 对针对目标表征属性/过程的干预作出选择性响应；

1zmpds93cqw.s: causally affects the intended downstream consumer when manipulated while first-order representation is preserved;
1zmpds93cqw.t: 在保持一阶表征不变的情况下受到操纵时，对预期的下游消费者产生因果影响；

k73eorxh6x.s: outperforms simpler B0/B1 explanations under held-out interventions, not merely under in-distribution decoding.
k73eorxh6x.t: 在留出用于评估的干预下优于更简单的 B0/B1 解释，而不仅仅是在分布内解码中占优。

2fdaskzuwv1.s: After index-specific rules are fixed and validated, report a vector of pass/fail/inconclusive results rather than a single verdict. An unspecified or unvalidated index is not confirmatory-ready; do not manufacture a verdict from the shared checklist. A reproducible split outcome is a substantive finding about the selected operationalizations, per §7.
2fdaskzuwv1.t: 在特定于索引的规则确定并经验证之后，报告由通过/未通过/无定论结果构成的向量，而非单一裁决。未明确规定或未经验证的索引尚不具备验证性使用的条件；不得根据共享检查清单拼凑出裁决。依照 §7，可复现的分裂结果是关于所选操作化定义的实质性发现。

24v425h6tgg.s: If these conditions cannot be met under any index, the programme should not use the phrase ⟦1⟧strict metarepresentation⟦/1⟧ for that system.
24v425h6tgg.t: 如果在任何索引下都无法满足这些条件，该研究计划就不应对该系统使用⟦1⟧严格元表征⟦/1⟧这一说法。

18vjlltgt2v.s: E0-B does ⟦1⟧not⟦/1⟧ establish that this operationalization exhausts the concept of metarepresentation.
18vjlltgt2v.t: E0-B ⟦1⟧并不⟦/1⟧确立这一操作化定义穷尽了元表征的概念。

lb7mib14j5.s: ⟦1⟧Ground truth is available by construction.⟦/1⟧ The synthetic environment exposes ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, and intervention targets. The initial reference must additionally support tractable exact conditional probabilities; access to realized states alone does not provide this.
lb7mib14j5.t: ⟦1⟧真值通过构造即可获得。⟦/1⟧合成环境公开⟦2⟧、⟦3⟧、⟦4⟧及干预目标。初始参照还必须支持可处理的精确条件概率；仅能获取已实现的状态并不能提供这一点。

19sq77bcxq6.s: ⟦1⟧Candidate variables are supplied by the experimenter.⟦/1⟧ E0 tests representation and use of known targets; it does not test spontaneous discovery of an internal ontology.
19sq77bcxq6.t: ⟦1⟧候选变量由实验者提供。⟦/1⟧E0 检验的是对已知目标的表征与使用；它并不检验对内部本体的自发发现。

1q0m1pk6tnx.s: ⟦1⟧Measurement validation precedes calibration.⟦/1⟧ Exact-reference estimator and complete-evaluator checks precede pilot threshold selection, which precedes independent confirmation. Held-out calibration and matched decoder classes alone are insufficient.
1q0m1pk6tnx.t: ⟦1⟧测量验证先于校准。⟦/1⟧精确参照估计量检查和完整评估器检查先于试点阈值选择，而后者又先于独立确证。仅有留出用于评估的校准和匹配的解码器类别是不够的。

11zl3bnyun9.s: ⟦1⟧On-support interventions can be designed without destroying unrelated computations.⟦/1⟧ This must be empirically verified rather than assumed.
11zl3bnyun9.t: ⟦1⟧可以在不破坏无关计算的前提下设计支持集内的干预。⟦/1⟧这一点必须经过实证验证，而不能仅凭假定。

1ri86tp6mc9.s: ⟦1⟧Task value is a legitimate local criterion.⟦/1⟧ Causal use is defined relative to the tested task and consumer; absence of use in one task does not prove universal absence of function.
1ri86tp6mc9.t: ⟦1⟧任务价值是一项合理的局部标准。⟦/1⟧因果使用是相对于所检验的任务和消费者来界定的；在某一任务中未被使用，并不能证明该功能普遍不存在。

1ow33zqpwl5.s: ⟦1⟧Representational properties/processes are operationally specified before data inspection.⟦/1⟧ E0-B cannot infer a meta-target after the fact from whichever latent dimension decodes best.
1ow33zqpwl5.t: ⟦1⟧表征属性/过程须在查看数据之前完成操作性规定。⟦/1⟧E0-B 不能事后根据哪个潜在���度解码效果最好来推断元目标。

1vy6j8mjna5.t: 12.1 E0-A 验证的是监控，而非元表征

1wpaoz8gw79.s: A perfectly successful E0-A system may still be only a sophisticated internal telemetry channel.
1wpaoz8gw79.t: 一个完全成功的 E0-A 系统仍可能只是一条精巧的内部遥测通道。

21d9htfs2ej.t: 12.2 E0-B 是相对于定义而言的

mc4zwqir46.s: Metarepresentation is contested. E0-B can validate one operational criterion against specified alternatives; it cannot settle all philosophical or cognitive-scientific definitions.
mc4zwqir46.t: 元表征是一个有争议的概念。E0-B 可以针对明确规定的替代方案验证某一操作性标准；它无法裁定所有哲学或认知科学上的定义。

1z2q0s3xiou.t: 12.3 条件信息估计依赖于模型

84vvd2ed31.s: Cross-validated log-loss differences approximate conditional information only relative to the decoder class and data regime. Poor auxiliary predictors can create misleading residual uncertainty or information estimates.
84vvd2ed31.t: 交叉验证的对数损失差异仅在相对于解码器类别和数据条件时才近似于条件信息。较差的辅助预测器可能产生误导性的剩余不确定性或信息估计。

a57wgpgu6e.s: 12.4 Synthetic modularity is an experimental scaffold
a57wgpgu6e.t: 12.4 合成模块化是一种实验支架

109l8saumu7.s: Clean private states, encoders, and intervention points are engineered conveniences. They should not be read as claims about anatomical modules or a literal neural information seam.
109l8saumu7.t: 干净的私有状态、编码器和干预点都是为工程便利而设计的。不应将其解读为关于解剖学模块或字面意义上的神经信息接缝的主张。

kc1xiv3f49.t: 12.5 因果使用是相对于消费者而言的

8al5lu3kiz.s: A message may be unused by the tested coordinator yet useful elsewhere. E0 establishes only the causal relation explicitly tested.
8al5lu3kiz.t: 某条消息可能未被所检验的协调者使用，但在其他地方仍然有用。E0 仅确立经明确检验的因果关系。

w0mrlpuxfw.s: ⟦1⟧ does not imply ⟦2⟧. Efficient rate reduction requires an actual cost or opportunity pressure.
w0mrlpuxfw.t: ⟦1⟧并不意味着⟦2⟧。高效的速率降低需要实际存在的成本压力或机会压力。

9pqlh41jjf.s: 12.7 Local validity does not establish ecology
9pqlh41jjf.t: 12.7 局部有效性并不确立生态

g8xsh9zaqo.s: Even successful E0-A and E0-B experiments validate only local constructs. Ecology-level claims require reproducible interactions among multiple independently validated systems across tasks or architectures.
g8xsh9zaqo.t: 即使 E0-A 和 E0-B 实验取得成功，也只能验证局部构念。生态层面的主张需要多个经独立验证的系统在不同任务或架构之间表现出可复现的相互作用。

1rt5wdwjoql.s: Passing E0-A does not imply E0-B. Passing either does not imply ecology.
1rt5wdwjoql.t: 通过 E0-A 并不意味着通过 E0-B。通过其中任何一项都不意味着生态成立。

hjcszai7j2.s: E0 exists to prevent later sophistication from compensating for a bad construct. If the substrate cannot survive these tests, stop before building the ecology around it.
hjcszai7j2.t: E0 的存在是为了防止后期的复杂设计弥补一个有缺陷的构念。如果基底无法经受这些检验，就应在围绕它构建生态之前停止。
